       c.convertedManaCost,

  AND c.type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.artist, c.convertedManaCost

questions.nlq: Hey! Could you help me find the popular cards that are legal in Commander? I'd love to see their names and how many different sets each of them was printed in.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: For this question, "popular" means cards whose edhrecRank is 1000 or lower (i.e., they rank among the top‑1000 on EDHRec).
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT c.name,
       CASE WHEN c.printings IS NOT NULL
            THEN (LENGTH(c.printings) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.printings, ',', '')) + 1)
            ELSE 0
       END AS set_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.edhrecRank IS NOT NULL
  AND c.edhrecRank <= 1000;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: For this question, "popular" means cards that have been printed in at least five distinct sets (i.e., the printings column contains five or more set codes).

FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.printings IS NOT NULL
  AND (length(c.printings) - length(replace(c.printings, ',', '')) ) >= 4;

SELECT name, manaCost
FROM cards
WHERE edhrecRank <= 50000
  AND type LIKE '%Planeswalker%';

SELECT c.name, c.manaCost
FROM cards c
JOIN (
    SELECT l.uuid
    FROM legalities l
    WHERE lower(l.status) = 'legal'
    GROUP BY l.uuid
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) >= 5
) pop ON pop.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.type LIKE '%Planeswalker%';

SELECT c.name, c.manaCost
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.type LIKE '%Planeswalker%'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.manaCost
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) >= 5

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l."format") >= 5;

WITH card_set_ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id,
        c.uuid,
        c.setCode,
        c.convertedManaCost,
        c.name,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.setCode) as set_card_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.setCode ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC) as mana_rank
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.convertedManaCost IS NOT NULL
),
high_mana_cards AS (
    SELECT id, uuid, setCode, convertedManaCost, name
    FROM card_set_ranks
    WHERE set_card_count >= 10
      AND CAST(mana_rank AS REAL) / CAST(set_card_count AS REAL) <= 0.10
),
card_legal_formats AS (
    SELECT 
        uuid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT format) AS format_count
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'Legal'
    GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT DISTINCT hmc.name AS card_name
FROM high_mana_cards hmc
JOIN card_legal_formats clf ON hmc.uuid = clf.uuid
WHERE clf.format_count >= 3
